items.text: Welcome. Your answers here are the first thing your agent ever learns about you — they shape your plan, your training, and how you are treated from the very first session. Answer honestly; almost everything can be skipped or changed later in chat.

items.prompt: How old are you?
items.hint: This framework is strictly for adults, 18+.

items.prompt: How deep should this onboarding go?
items.hint: Light keeps it to the essentials, Medium adds a solid profile, Deep adds the thorough sections — interests, gear, history, and self-reflection. You can always go deeper in conversation later.

items.prompt: What should I call you — a name, a nickname, or the feminine name you go by?
Which pronouns fit how you want to be seen?
How experienced are you with this side of yourself?
choices: Brand new — mostly fantasy so far
Active — a regular part of my life

items.prompt: How much time can you realistically give this on an ordinary day?
items.hint: Routines and sessions get planned around this — be honest, not optimistic.
choices: An hour or more a day

items.prompt: Who's around while you do this?
items.hint: This decides how private your tasks and rituals can be.
choices: With a partner — we're in this together
With a partner who doesn't know

items.prompt: Tell me about your living situation in your own words.
Anything in your weekly schedule I should plan around — work, family, sleep?
What do you want out of this?
choices: Be corrupted — want it more than I should

items.prompt: How fast should things move?
choices: Fast — push past my comfort zone

items.prompt: And how far does the road go, in your ideal future?
In your own words: where are you right now on this journey, and what pulled you here?
What holds you back right now — difficulties, fears, or obstacles that keep getting in the way?
Any hard limits — things that must never come up, in any form?
items.hint: Leave blank if none. I take these literally; you can add more any time.

items.text:
**How I should treat you**

These answers shape my tone, my demands, and my language from the first session on.

items.prompt: What tone should I usually take with you?
How much should I decide for you, versus ask first?
choices: Decide day-to-day things, ask before big changes

items.prompt: May I turn up the intensity over time?
choices: Only with my explicit OK each time
Small steps on your own, big ones with my OK
Freely — within my limits, surprise me

items.prompt: When I hesitate, resist, or make excuses — how hard should I push? (1 = gentle and patient, 10 = relentless and coercive)

items.text:
**Almost done**

Your agent reads every answer before your first conversation — honesty here saves time there. Anything you skip can be shared in chat later.

items.prompt: Anything else your agent should know before you start?
